LanguageData.MX_ZhaoliNormal.label: Zhaoli's daily wear
LanguageData.MX_ZhaoliNormal.description: Zhaoli's violet-black attire protects her body and wings. Improves protection, carrying capacity, movement speed, melee dodge and melee damage, and reduces incoming damage. Never breaks.
LanguageData.MX_ZhaoliHood.label: Zhaoli's hood
LanguageData.MX_ZhaoliHood.description: Zhaoli's dark hood conceals her halo and protects her entire head. Reduces melee cooldown, stagger duration and mental break threshold. Never breaks.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DuanzhanBlade.label: Severance
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DuanzhanBlade.description: Zhaoli's melee armament, with a white blade that pierces heavy armor. Grants Severing Slash, a sweeping horizontal strike. Never breaks.
LanguageData.MX_Zhaoli_DuanzhanBlade.tools.0.label: Severance
